arguments.value: A Chinese energy project cooperation agreement between Xi'an Zhonghong New Energy Technology and Boxing County Chengli Gas Supply for a coke dry quenching (CDQ) and waste heat power generation project. Party A will invest in, design, build, operate, and maintain the system, while Party B provides land, coal coke, utility access, permits support, and buys all electricity generated. The project is a BO model, expected to cost RMB 176 million, with a 20-year term, a 12-month construction period, and payment based on electricity output at set rates, with adjustments if grid prices change. The agreement also covers maintenance, metering, ownership and IP, quality responsibilities, profit-sharing from government incentives, breach penalties, force majeure, dispute resolution, and termination rights.
